## Testbenches and simulation

Heuristic scan (`.claude/skills/review-gateware-project/scan_tests.sh`, 2026-09-27) over each shallow clone for test/sim directories (`tb/`, `test/`, `sim/`, ...), testbench-named files (`*_tb.v`, `tb_*.vhd`, `*_test.py`, ...) and simulator mentions (iverilog, Verilator, GHDL, cocotb, VUnit) in build scripts. It is a name/path heuristic, not proof the tests run or pass — verify before relying on one. Repos not listed here had nothing matching.

The **Run by make** column (`make_tests`, 2026-09-28) comes from `scan_make_tests.py` candidates checked by hand-reading the Makefiles: the make command, simulator and testbench files a target actually runs. Lint-only and synthesis-only uses of simulators are excluded. Nothing was executed.

Clock: ICE_CLK pin, run_impl FREQMHZ=12 (12 MHz). No .gitmodules found.

- **Functions**: sdram, board-hw, examples
- **ULX3S build**: testram.v (top) + sdram.vhd + ulx3s_v20.lpf, via Makefile/ulx3s.mk (LPF: ulx3s_v20.lpf)
- **Reuse**: sdram.vhd (VHDL SDRAM controller, translated from a known-good Verilog original — useful as a VHDL-flow reference)
- **Tests**: tools: iverilog
- **Notes**: README is a single line crediting the Verilog source; minimal test/experiment repo, not a full application

### zipotron__ziposoc
- **Functions**: soc-cpu, uart
- **ULX3S build**: root (Makefile, ulx3s_v20.lpf) (LPF: ulx3s_v20.lpf)
- **Reuse**: zipocpu.v/alu.v/comparator.v/expander.v (small CPU core), memory_map.v
- **Tests**: 4 tb/test files;tools: iverilog
- **Notes**: Minimal SoC with several testbenches (*_tb.v) but only a 1-line README; no license header found.
